page: Microsoft Azure L80s_v4 is a storage and memory-optimized virtual machine from the Lsv4 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 40 physical Intel Xeon 8573C processor cores with an x86_64 architecture. Operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz, this processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and INT8 operations. The server is equipped with 640.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes 19199 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. No GPUs are present on this instance.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core processing and high-throughput capabilities. The system achieved top-tier performance in Geekbench multi-core and image processing tests, alongside strong results in Passmark CPU and database operations. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 223.47 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 5387.5 GB/sec for cached small-block reads. For web serving, the instance demonstrates top-tier static web serving throughput of 105.75 GB/sec. It also sustains high-performance database operations, processing 91.92 million Redis SET operations per second.

Given its high resource density, the L80s_v4 offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive local storage capacity paired with substantial memory and compute resources. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and nearly 19 TB of local storage make it highly suitable for large-scale relational databases, NoSQL data stores, and big data analytics. Additionally, the inclusion of Intel AMX instructions enables efficient CPU-based machine learning and LLM inference, as demonstrated by strong prompt processing and text generation benchmarks for medium-sized models.
